agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Analyzes the user's research query, elaborates on it with points and counter-points, and decomposes it into specific search topics.

agents.name: Retriever
agents.role: Performs parallel academic searches (OpenAlex, arXiv) and web scraping to gather high-fidelity source material.

agents.name: Synthesizer
agents.role: Consolidates semantic facts and GraphRAG relationships into a structured insight overview.

agents.name: Evaluator
agents.role: Drafts the final report through a loop of generation, critique, fact-checking, and refinement to ensure scientific accuracy.
